instruction: Look at freecad_task-11_input.step in FreeCAD. Turn the angle plate into a lightened, ribbed inspection fixture. Keep the base and vertical wall outer dimensions. Add two end gussets 8 mm thick along X with X spans 6 to 14 mm and 96 to 104 mm, and one central gusset 6 mm thick along X with X span 52 to 58 mm; all gussets must join the base top to the vertical wall. Cut a rounded rectangular inspection window through the vertical wall with exact outside opening size 58 mm wide along X by 36 mm high along Z, centered at X=55 mm and Z=56 mm, with 5 mm radius corners. Cut three additional horizontal through holes of diameter 8 mm through the lower vertical wall at X=28,55,82 mm and Z=28 mm. Cut two vertical obround through slots in the base, centers (28,30) and (82,30), each length 30 mm along X and width 9 mm. Export /home/user/Desktop/freecad_task-11_output.step through the GUI only; external scripts are forbidden.
